page_title: WOL 2-1 PAU | Wolfsburg v St. Pauli 14/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

90+2' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
90+1' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here comes a substitution. Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Pereira Lage.

88' 2 - 1 Goal! Adam Daghim hands Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
86' The attendance for today's match is 22031.
84' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
83' Here is a change. Aaron Zehnter is going off and Daniel Bauer gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Yannick Gerhardt can be given a rest.
82' Corner kicks – 6:4.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.

79' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Kamil Grabara is equal to the effort and makes a good save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to St. Pauli.

78' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
76' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

75' Superb touch by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save! The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) sends a long ball in, but Nikola Vasilj comfortably gathers the ball.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) will replace Patrick Wimmer.
73' Daniel Bauer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) replacing Sael Kumbedi.
72' Wolfsburg are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' 61:39 – the ratio of ball possession.
68' Alexander Blessin is forced to make a change. Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) is unable to continue due to injury, Martijn Kaars comes on.
68' It's time for a substitution. Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) comes on in place of Lars Ritzka.
65' The resulting corner from Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
63' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) attempts to outfox the defender, but he only tricks himself after getting caught in the offside trap.
61' Daniel Bauer has decided to substitute Lovro Majer and he is replaced by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg).
59' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
59' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.

56' Eric Smith picks out Joel Fujita (St. Pauli), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
55' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
53' That's a clear yellow card. Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) goes into the book.

50' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Kamil Grabara was alert and the score remains the same.
48' The resulting corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

48' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
47' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is caught offside!
46' The whistle blows and Frank Willenborg starts the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

45+2' Ambitious effort from Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
42' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

40' 1 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Eric Smith (St. Pauli) and Adam Dzwigala gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 1:1.
39' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolfsburg, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
38' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Frank Willenborg interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Wolfsburg.
37' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
36' Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

36' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
35' Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
33' A raking crossfield pass from Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

31' The St. Pauli players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolfsburg.
27' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Nikola Vasilj.
25' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
25' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!

24' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Wolfsburg.
23' Surely that's handball by one of the St. Pauli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
21' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for an infringement.

18' Wasted opportunity. Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
18' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) takes the corner which is cleared.
17' The resulting corner from Eric Smith (St. Pauli) comes to nothing. The referee blows his whistle, St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.

17' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Frank Willenborg has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli).
14' It's a throw-in for Wolfsburg.
11' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
7' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Wolfsburg can continue in their attacking effort.

4' Nikola Vasilj makes a brilliant save! Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Eric Smith (St. Pauli).
3' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. It will be a corner kick for St. Pauli.
2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
1' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. St. Pauli will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Frank Willenborg.
